verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed a live llms.txt at docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured index of the documentation. Doc pages are also served as raw markdown (.md URLs), and there is a dedicated agent-setup guide for connecting coding agents, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or single-file full-content export, and no independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
